## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior and any related issue.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Relevant documentation updated

For UI/device changes, list the browser, TV/receiver model and firmware tested,
remote/keyboard checks performed, and any hardware behavior still unverified.

## Licensing and privacy

- [ ] I have the right to submit this contribution under MIT.
- [ ] New third-party code, assets, services or tools have sources/licenses in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`, with required notices retained.
- [ ] The change contains no credentials, signing material, private device data or media without redistribution rights.
